sourceNote: Distances are gate-to-gate and include descent. Standard route values use GPS-tracked distances; Northern Circuit is approximately 97 km.

before.title: 6-Day Kilimanjaro Marangu Route and Hotel Stay
before.heroSummary: A six-day hut-based Kilimanjaro climb with an acclimatization day at Horombo Hut and hotel nights before and after the trek.

after.title: 6-Day Kilimanjaro Marangu Route
after.heroSummary: A six-day hut-based Kilimanjaro climb with an acclimatization day at Horombo Hut. Hotel accommodation can be arranged separately on request.

before.title: 9-Day Kilimanjaro Northern Circuit Route
before.heroSummary: A nine-day Kilimanjaro trek from the western rainforest across the Shira Plateau and around the quieter northern slopes to Uhuru Peak.

after.title: 9-Day Kilimanjaro Northern Circuit Route
after.heroSummary: A nine-day Kilimanjaro trek from the western rainforest across the Shira Plateau and around the quieter northern slopes to Uhuru Peak.

before.title: Kilimanjaro Shira Plateau Day Hike
before.heroSummary: Experience Kilimanjaro in one day with a high-altitude hike across the Shira Plateau and an optional extension to Cathedral Point at 3,962 metres.

after.title: Kilimanjaro Shira Plateau Day Hike
after.heroSummary: Experience Kilimanjaro in one day with a high-altitude hike across the Shira Plateau and an optional extension to Cathedral Point at 3,962 metres.

before.title: 6-Day Kilimanjaro Umbwe Route and Hotel Stay
before.heroSummary: A steep and quiet six-day Kilimanjaro climb via Umbwe, with hotel nights before and after the trek.

after.title: 6-Day Kilimanjaro Umbwe Route
after.heroSummary: A steep and quiet six-day Kilimanjaro climb via Umbwe. Hotel accommodation can be arranged separately on request.
